# Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta17

This beta fixes two map-card issues found during field testing.

## Underlay calibration range

- Increased the manual **East offset** range from ±5 m to **±10 m**.
- Increased the manual **North offset** range from ±5 m to **±10 m**.
- Kept the existing 0.1 m adjustment step and ±5° rotation range unchanged.

This is especially useful for maps where the vendor/static georeference is several metres away from the visually correct satellite/orthophoto alignment.

## Multi-mower notification paging

- Multi-mower notifications now keep their own page index instead of sharing the single-mower notification dialog page state.
- Fixes later notification pages briefly appearing and then snapping back to an earlier page after Home Assistant state updates or dialog re-renders.
- Existing notification ordering, read/unread actions and configured page sizing are unchanged.

## Release build safety

- Made the beta16 cumulative runtime preparation idempotent before normalization so repeated release preparation no longer risks stripping `include_current_cycle=0` from the lightweight map request.
